<thought>Based on the notes, the subnetwork consists of two resistors in series where one resistor is twice the value of the other. Let the smaller resistor be R and the larger be 2R. Their series total is 3R = 6.667 Ω, giving R ≈ 2.222 Ω and 2R ≈ 4.445 Ω. The resistors are labeled left‑to‑right, so we name them R1 (2.222 Ω) and R2 (4.445 Ω) with an intermediate node B between them.</thought>
